status: Native asynchronous receipts, bare-command attachments and SSH reconnect ownership verified locally; full migration remains incomplete
findings: Withholding explicit extension attachments violated the existing native template/extension regression; removed the withholding.
An unsolicited second receipt for the same ID caused prompt-receipts-test to observe accepted instead of conflict; terminal annotations are persisted for query only.
Native extension handler exceptions may still end with local completed; commandExecuted identifies local handling, never task success.

Appending attachments to a bare extension command without a literal space changed native command parsing and caused one unintended model request. The host now inserts the argument delimiter only for a bare slash input when adding text attachments; real native tests finish with zero model requests.

Concurrent SSH reconnects could overwrite a newer connection after awaiting old Agent shutdown, leaving an unowned ready Agent/Bun child. Revalidate request token, node revision and lifecycle after shutdown and SSH handshake.
